toolCalls.name: StructuredOutput

output.brief:
The fall in first-contact resolution is almost entirely explained by the 14 April Finance change, not by the new starters. That change cut the credit an agent can apply on a call from £100 to £25. Larger adjustments are now blocked and automatically referred to the back-office Billing Resolution team. The share of billing calls referred rose from 7% to 54% in the same week the dashboard fell. Referred calls resolve at about 33%, against 82% for the rest, and both rates are unchanged from before. Referral rates and FCR are the same for April-intake, mid-tenure and long-tenured agents. The tariff-enquiry share doubled, but those calls still resolve at 85%. The IVR redesign came two weeks after the drop began. Customer Operations was not consulted on the Finance change.

Do not put April-intake agents on performance plans. It would punish the wrong group.

Next step: agree a higher in-call credit limit with Finance, with post-call sampling of credits. Trial it on two teams for six weeks and track FCR and unsupported credits. The Finance controller has said this is the route to a higher limit. I'm fairly confident, though I did not check workload or IVR data directly.
